content: Delivered: appeals table + calibration_events table migration. polaris-types::appeal::AppealStatus state machine with transition_to validation. AppealRepo trait + Pg impl. CalibrationEventRepo trait + Pg impl. POST /api/appeals (public, IP-rate-limited via SHA-256 hashed IPs, 5/hour). POST /api/appeals/:id/decide (auth-gated, original-author-excluded defense-in-depth). GET /api/appeals/:id. Routing extended with exclude_moderator field; appeal review never assigned to original action's author. On Reversed decision: action reversed via #36's path + CalibrationEvent written for original author (feedback, not discipline). 5-test integration suite covers: submit + 429 rate limit, state machine invalid transition, routing exclusion, calibration event written, original-author 403.
